models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.why: The 27B everyone measures every new inference stack against: speculative decoding, context lookup and prefix caching keep moving the same weights from 82 to 381 tok/s on one 3090.

engines.hardware: iPad Pro + Thunderbolt Sapphire Radeon AI PRO R9700 eGPU
engines.quant: Q4 quantization, 131K context, DFlash2 draft-tree decoding (up from 31 tok/s standard and 109 tok/s with MTP speculative decoding)

engines.hardware: Jailbroken PlayStation 5, 12 GiB direct GPU memory (native Vulkan app on Mihawk-99's RADV/Mesa port)
engines.quant: 2-bit UD-IQ2_XXS quant of Qwen3.8-27B; models load from USB straight into GPU memory (no mmap)

NVFP4 weights via SGLang, DFlash2 speculative decoding with a 4-bit drafter proposing 16 tokens per verification pass, BF16 KV cache, thinking disabled; median of four runs (65K context still 67 tok/s, 260K 38 tok/s)
